items.name: 治疗药膏
items.description: 你饮用此药水后，将在1小时内获得对雷霆伤害的抗性。
items.descriptionEn: When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to thunder damage for 1 hour.

items.name: 速度药水
items.description: 你饮用此药水后，将获得“加速”法术的效果，持续1分钟（无需专注）。药水的黄色液体中带有黑色条纹，并自行旋转。
items.descriptionEn: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the haste spell for 1 minute (no concentration required). The potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.

items.name: 水中呼吸药水
items.description: 饮用此药水后，你可在1小时内进行水下呼吸。其浑浊的绿色液体散发着海水的味道，内部漂浮着类似水母的气泡。
items.descriptionEn: You can breathe underwater for 1 hour after drinking this potion. Its cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

items.name: 恢复药膏
items.description:
这个直径3英寸的玻璃罐内装有1d4 + 1剂浓稠的混合物，略带芦荟的气味。罐子及其内容物重半磅。  
作为一项动作，可以吞服或涂抹一剂药膏。接受药膏的生物恢复2d8 + 2点生命值，停止中毒状态，并治愈所有疾病。
items.descriptionEn:
This glass jar, 3 inches in diameter, contains 1d4 + 1 doses of a thick mixture that smells faintly of aloe. The jar and its contents weigh 1/2 pound.
As an action, one dose of the ointment can be swallowed or applied to the skin. The creature that receives it regains 2d8 + 2 hit points, ceases to be poisoned, and is cured of any disease.

items.name: 动物影响指环
items.description:
此戒指拥有3次充能，每日黎明时会恢复1d3次已消耗的充能。佩戴此戒指时，你可以使用一个动作消耗1次充能来施放以下法术之一：  
动物友好（豁免难度13）  
恐惧（豁免难度13），仅针对智力为3或更低的野兽  
与动物交流
items.descriptionEn:
This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells:
Animal friendship (save DC 13)
Fear (save DC 13), targeting only beasts that have an Intelligence of 3 or lower
Speak with animals

items.name: 精灵召唤指环
items.description:
佩戴此戒指时，你可以以一个动作说出其咒语，从风元素位面召唤出特定的精灵。精灵会出现在你选择的120英尺内的空置空间中。它将持续到你专注（如同施放法术）为止，最多1小时，或直到其生命值降至0。之后它会返回自己的位面。  
被召唤期间，精灵对你和你的同伴友好。它会服从你下达的任何命令，无论何种语言。
items.descriptionEn:
While wearing this ring, you can speak its command word as an action to summon a particular djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of you. It remains as long as you concentrate (as if concentrating on a spell), to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 hit points. It then returns to its home plane.
While summoned, the djinni is friendly to you and your companions. It obeys any commands you give it, no matter what language you use. If you fail to command it, the djinni defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions.
After the djinni departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies.

items.name: 元素统御指环
items.description:
此戒指与四大元素位面之一相连。游戏主持人可选择或随机决定其连接的位面。  
佩戴此戒指时，你在对抗该位面的元素生物时有优势，而它们在攻击你时则处于劣势。此外，你还可以获得基于所连元素位面的特性。  
戒指有5次充能。每日黎明时会恢复1d4 + 1次已消耗的充能。从戒指中施放的法术豁免难度为17。  
***风元素统御之戒***。
items.descriptionEn:
This ring is linked to one of the four Elemental Planes. The GM chooses or randomly determines the linked plane.
While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against elementals from the linked plane, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the linked plane.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.
***Ring of Air Elemental Command.*** You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on an air elemental. In addition, when you fall, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling. You can also speak and understand Auran.
If you help slay an air elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You have resistance to lightning damage.
You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: chain lightning (3 charges), gust of wind (2 charges), or wind wall (1 charge).
***Ring of Earth Elemental Command.*** You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on an earth elemental. In addition, you can move in difficult terrain that is composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt as if it were normal terrain. You can also speak and understand Terran.
If you help slay an earth elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You have resistance to acid damage.
You can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were difficult terrain. If you end your turn there, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: stone shape (2 charges), stoneskin (3 charges), or wall of stone (3 charges).
***Ring of Fire Elemental Command.*** You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on a fire elemental. In addition, you have resistance to fire damage. You can also speak and understand Ignan.
If you help slay a fire elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You are immune to fire damage.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: burning hands (1 charge), fireball (2 charges), and wall of fire (3 charges).
***Ring of Water Elemental Command.*** You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on a water elemental. In addition, you can stand on and walk across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground. You can also speak and understand Aquan.
If you help slay a water elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You can breathe underwater and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: create or destroy water (1 charge), control water (3 charges), ice storm (2 charges), or wall of ice (3 charges).

effects: advantage on attack rolls against elementals from the linked plane
disadvantage on attack rolls against you from elementals from the linked plane

items.descriptionEn: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing it, you can use your reaction to expend 1 of its charges to succeed on that saving throw instead.

effects: succeed on failed Dexterity saving throw

items.name: 羽毛坠落指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，如果你跌落，每回合会下落60英尺，并且不会因坠落而受到伤害。
items.descriptionEn: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

items.name: 自由行动指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，困难地形不会增加你的移动消耗。此外，魔法无法降低你的速度，也无法使你陷入麻痹或被束缚状态。
items.descriptionEn: While you wear this ring, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce your speed nor cause you to be paralyzed or restrained.

effects: difficult terrain doesn't cost extra movement
cannot be paralyzed or restrained by magic

items.name: 隐形指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你可以以一个动作施展“隐形术”。你所穿戴或携带的物品也会与你一同隐形。你保持隐形状态直到指环被取下、你发动攻击或施放法术，或你使用一个附赠动作再次显现。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you can turn invisible as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is invisible with you. You remain invisible until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell, or until you use a bonus action to become visible again.

stats.duration: until ring removed, attack, or cast a spell

items.name: 跳跃指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你可以以一个附赠动作无次数限制地从指环中施放“跳跃”法术，但施放时只能以自己为目标。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you can cast the jump spell from it as a bonus action at will, but can target only yourself when you do so.

items.name: 心灵屏障指环
items.description:
佩戴此指环时，你对允许其他生物读取你思想、判断你是否说谎、知晓你的阵营或生物类型的相关魔法免疫。除非你允许，否则其他生物无法通过心灵感应与你交流。  
你可以以一个动作使指环变得隐形，直至你再次以一个动作使其显形、你取下指环或你死亡为止。  
如果你在佩戴指环时死亡，你的灵魂会进入指环中，除非指环中已包含一个灵魂。
items.descriptionEn:
While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.
You can use an action to cause the ring to become invisible until you use another action to make it visible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.
If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication.

items.name: 防护指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你获得+1的AC和豁免检定加值。
items.descriptionEn: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

items.name: 再生指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，每10分钟你会恢复1d6点生命值，前提是你的生命值至少为1点。如果你失去身体部位，只要你在整个恢复期间生命值始终不低于1点，指环会在1d6+1天后使缺失部位重新生长并恢复全部功能。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you regain 1d6 hit points every 10 minutes, provided that you have at least 1 hit point. If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after 1d6 + 1 days if you have at least 1 hit point the whole time.

items.name: 抗性指环
items.description:
佩戴此指环时，你对一种伤害类型具有抗性。指环中的宝石会标明该伤害类型，由游戏主持人选择或随机决定。  
| d10 | 伤害类型 | 宝石 |  
|---|---|---|  
| 1 | 酸性 | 珍珠 |  
| 2 | 寒冷 | 电气石 |  
| 3 | 火焰 | 红宝石 |  
| 4 | 力场 | 蓝宝石 |  
| 5 | 雷电 | 黄玉 |  
| 6 | 腐蚀 | 黑曜石 |  
| 7 | 毒素 | 紫水晶 |  
| 8 | 心灵 | 玉髓 |  
| 9 | 光亮 | 石英 |  
| 10 | 雷鸣 | 尖晶石 |
items.descriptionEn:
You have resistance to one damage type while wearing this ring. The gem in the ring indicates the type, which the GM chooses or determines randomly.
| d10 | Damage Type | Gem |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Acid | Pearl |
| 2 | Cold | Tourmaline |
| 3 | Fire | Garnet |
| 4 | Force | Sapphire |
| 5 | Lightning | Citrine |
| 6 | Necrotic | Jet |

| 9 | Radiant | Topaz |
| 10 | Thunder | Spinel |

items.descriptionEn: You have resistance to lightning damage while wearing this citrine ring.

items.name: 护甲抗死亡能量指环
items.description: 佩戴此黑曜石戒指时，你对死亡伤害有抗性。
items.descriptionEn: You have resistance to necrotic damage while wearing this jet ring.

items.name: 护甲抗毒素指环
items.description: 佩戴此紫水晶戒指时，你对毒素伤害有抗性。
items.descriptionEn: You have resistance to poison damage while wearing this amethyst ring.

items.name: 护甲抗心灵能量指环
items.description: 佩戴此翡翠戒指时，你对心灵伤害有抗性。
items.descriptionEn: You have resistance to psychic damage while wearing this jade ring.

items.name: 护甲抗光辉能量指环
items.description: 佩戴此托帕石戒指时，你对神圣伤害有抗性。
items.descriptionEn: You have resistance to radiant damage while wearing this topaz ring.

items.name: 护甲抗雷鸣指环
items.description: 佩戴此尖晶石戒指时，你对雷鸣伤害有抗性。
items.descriptionEn: You have resistance to thunder damage while wearing this spinel ring.

items.name: 流星指环
items.description:
佩戴此指环时，在昏暗光线下或黑暗中，你可以随意施放幻影火把和从指环中发出的光。从指环中施放任一法术都需要一个动作。  
该指环有6个充能用于以下其他属性。每日黎明时，指环会恢复1d6次消耗的充能。  
***精灵之火***：你可以消耗1个充能作为动作，从指环中施放精灵之火。  
***球状闪电***：你可以消耗2个充能作为动作，制造1至4个直径3英尺的闪电球。
items.descriptionEn:
While wearing this ring in dim light or darkness, you can cast dancing lights and light from the ring at will. Casting either spell from the ring requires an action.
The ring has 6 charges for the following other properties. The ring regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.
***Faerie Fire.*** You can expend 1 charge as an action to cast faerie fire from the ring.
***Ball Lightning.*** You can expend 2 charges as an action to create one to four 3-foot-diameter spheres of lightning. The more spheres you create, the less powerful each sphere is individually.
Each sphere appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of you. The spheres last as long as you concentrate (as if concentrating on a spell), up to 1 minute. Each sphere sheds dim light in a 30-foot radius.
As a bonus action, you can move each sphere up to 30 feet, but no farther than 120 feet away from you. When a creature other than you comes within 5 feet of a sphere, the sphere discharges lightning at that creature and disappears. That creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes lightning damage based on the number of spheres you created.
| Spheres | Lightning Damage |
|---|---|
| 4 | 2d4 |
| 3 | 2d6 |
| 2 | 5d4 |
| 1 | 4d12 |
***Shooting Stars.*** You can expend 1 to 3 charges as an action. For every charge you expend, you launch a glowing mote of light from the ring at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. Each creature within a 15-foot cube originating from that point is showered in sparks and must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 法术储存指环
items.description:
此指环可储存施加于其上的法术，直到与之共鸣的佩戴者使用它们为止。指环最多可储存5级法术的总量。当被发现时，它包含由游戏主持人选择的1d6 - 1级储存的法术。  
任何生物都可以通过在施法时触碰指环，将1至5级的法术存入指环。该法术不会产生效果，仅被储存在指环中。如果指环无法容纳该法术，则法术会被消耗而无效果。所使用的法术位等级决定了储存的容量。
items.descriptionEn:
This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains 1d6 - 1 levels of stored spells chosen by the GM.
Any creature can cast a spell of 1st through 5th level into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.
While wearing this ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster, but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

items.name: 法术反弹指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你在对抗仅针对你的法术（而非区域效果）的豁免检定上具有优势。此外，如果你在豁免检定中掷出20，并且该法术为7级或更低，该法术对你无效，而是改为针对施法者，使用施法者的法术位等级、法术豁免难度等级、攻击加值和法术能力。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only you (not in an area of effect). In addition, if you roll a 20 for the save and the spell is 7th level or lower, the spell has no effect on you and instead targets the caster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.

items.name: 游泳指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你的游泳速度为每分钟40英尺。
items.descriptionEn: You have a swimming speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.

items.name: 心灵搬运指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你可以随意施放传送术，但只能对未被穿戴或携带的物体进行目标指定。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you can cast the telekinesis spell at will, but you can target only objects that aren't being worn or carried.

items.name: 公牛指环
items.description:
此指环有3个充能，每日黎明时会恢复1d3次消耗的充能。佩戴指环时，你可以用一个动作消耗1至3个充能，对60英尺内你能看到的一只生物发动攻击。指环会生成一个幽灵般的公羊头，并以+7的加值进行攻击检定。命中后，每消耗1个充能，目标会受到2d10点力场伤害，并被推开5英尺远离你。  
另外，你可以消耗1至3个充能作为动作，尝试破坏一个物体。
items.descriptionEn:
This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can use an action to expend 1 to 3 of its charges to attack one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The ring produces a spectral ram's head and makes its attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each charge you spend, the target takes 2d10 force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.
Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring's charges as an action to try to break an object you can see within 60 feet of you that isn't being worn or carried. The ring makes a Strength check with a +5 bonus for each charge you spend.

items.name: 三愿望指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你可以用一个动作消耗1个充能，从指环中施放许愿术。当你用完最后一个充能时，指环会变为非魔法物品。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the wish spell from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

items.name: 温暖指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你对寒冷伤害有抗性。此外，你以及你穿戴和携带的所有物品都不会受到低至华氏-50度的温度影响。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you have resistance to cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

effects: unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit

items.name: 水上行走指环
items.description: 佩戴此指环时，你可以站在并移动于任何液体表面，如同其为坚固地面一般。
items.descriptionEn: While wearing this ring, you can stand on and move across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground.

items.name: X光视觉指环
items.description:
佩戴此指环时，你可以用一个动作说出它的命令词。当你这样做时，你可以看见并穿透固体物质，持续1分钟。这种视野半径为30英尺。在你看来，该半径内的固体物体是透明的，不会阻挡光线通过。这种视野可以穿透1英尺厚的石头、1英寸厚的普通金属，或最多3英尺厚的木头或泥土。更厚的物质或一层薄铅会阻挡这种视野。  
每次你再次使用指环之前，...
items.descriptionEn:
While wearing this ring, you can use an action to speak its command word. When you do so, you can see into and through solid matter for 1 minute. This vision has a radius of 30 feet. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. The vision can penetrate 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances block the vision, as does a thin sheet of lead.
Whenever you use the ring again before taking a long rest, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

items.name: 眼袍
items.description:
这件长袍上装饰着类似眼睛的图案。当你穿着这件长袍时，你将获得以下好处：  
长袍使你能向所有方向视物，并且在依赖视觉的智慧（察觉）检定中获得优势。  
你拥有120英尺范围内的黑暗视觉。  
你能看见隐形生物和物体，以及看到灵界平面内120英尺范围内的事物。  
长袍上的眼睛无法被闭上或避开。尽管你可以闭上或避开自己的眼睛，但你始终被视为能够看见。
items.descriptionEn:
This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits:
The robe lets you see in all directions, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
You have darkvision out to a range of 120 feet.
You can see invisible creatures and objects, as well as see into the Ethereal Plane, out to a range of 120 feet.
The eyes on the robe can't be closed or averted. Although you can close or avert your own eyes, you are never considered to be doing so while wearing this robe.
A light spell cast on the robe or a daylight spell cast within 5 feet of the robe causes you to be blinded for 1 minute. At the end of each of your turns, you can make a Constitution saving throw (DC 11 for light or DC 15 for daylight), ending the blindness on a success.

items.name: 光辉彩衣
items.description: 这件长袍有3点充能，每天黎明时恢复1d3点消耗的充能。当你穿着它时，你可以使用一个动作并消耗1点充能，使这件衣物在你下个回合结束前展现出炫目的色彩变化。在此期间，长袍在30英尺半径内散发明亮光亮，额外30英尺范围内为昏暗光亮。能够看到你的生物对你的攻击掷骰获得劣势。此外，任何在明亮光亮范围内且能看到你的生物，在长袍的魔法效果生效时也会受到此影响。
items.descriptionEn: This robe has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you wear it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cause the garment to display a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of your next turn. During this time, the robe sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Creatures that can see you have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, any creature in the bright light that can see you when the robe's power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become stunned until the effect ends.

effects: Sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.
Creatures that can see you have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
Any creature in the bright light that can see you when the robe's power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become stunned until the effect ends.
stats.duration: until the end of your next turn

items.name: 星辰长袍
items.description:
这件黑色或深蓝色长袍上绣有小的白色或银色星星。当你穿着它时，你在豁免检定中获得+1加值。  
长袍前部上方有六颗较大的星星。当你穿着这件长袍时，你可以使用一个动作取下一颗星星，并用它以5环法术施放“魔法飞弹”。每天日落时，1d6颗被移除的星星会重新出现在长袍上。  
当你穿着这件长袍时，你可以使用一个动作进入星辰界，同时携带你所穿戴或持有的所有物品。
items.descriptionEn:
This black or dark blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it.
Six stars, located on the robe's upper front portion, are particularly large. While wearing this robe, you can use an action to pull off one of the stars and use it to cast magic missile as a 5th-level spell. Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe.
While you wear the robe, you can use an action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you use an action to return to the plane you were on. You reappear in the last space you occupied, or if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.

items.name: 大法师长袍
items.description:
这件优雅的长袍由白色、灰色或黑色的精美布料制成，并饰有银色符文。长袍的颜色对应其制作时所对应的阵营。白色长袍用于善良，灰色用于中立，黑色用于邪恶。你无法与不符合你阵营的“大法师长袍”建立共鸣。  
当你穿着这件长袍时，你将获得以下好处：  
如果你未穿戴护甲，你的基础AC为15 + 你的敏捷调整值。  
你在豁免检定中获得优势。
items.descriptionEn:
This elegant garment is made from exquisite cloth of white, gray, or black and adorned with silvery runes. The robe's color corresponds to the alignment for which the item was created. A white robe was made for good, gray for neutral, and black for evil. You can't attune to a robe of the archmagi that doesn't correspond to your alignment.
You gain these benefits while wearing the robe:
If you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 15 + your Dexterity modifier.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Your spell save DC and spell attack bonus each increase by 2.

effects: If you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 15 + your Dexterity modifier.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Your spell save DC and spell attack bonus each increase by 2.

items.name: 实用物品长袍
items.description:
这件长袍覆盖着各种形状和颜色的布片。当你穿着长袍时，你可以使用一个动作拆下其中一片，使其变成它所代表的物体或生物。当最后一片被移除后，长袍就变成普通的衣物。  
长袍上有两种每种各两片的补丁：  
匕首  
黄铜灯（已装满并点燃）  
钢镜  
10英尺长杆  
麻绳（50英尺，缠绕）  
袋子  
此外，长袍还有4d4片其他补丁。游戏主持人选择这些补丁的具体内容。
items.descriptionEn:
This robe has cloth patches of various shapes and colors covering it. While wearing the robe, you can use an action to detach one of the patches, causing it to become the object or creature it represents. Once the last patch is removed, the robe becomes an ordinary garment.
The robe has two of each of the following patches:
Dagger
Bullseye lantern (filled and lit)
Steel mirror
10-foot pole
Hempen rope (50 feet, coiled)
Sack
In addition, the robe has 4d4 other patches. The GM chooses the patches or determines them randomly.
| d100 | Patch |
|---|---|
| 01-08 | Bag of 100 gp |
| 09-15 | Silver coffer (1 foot long, 6 inches wide and deep) worth 500 gp |
| 16-22 | Iron door (up to 10 feet wide and 10 feet high, barred on one side of your choice), which you can place in an opening you can reach; it conforms to fit the opening, attaching and hinging itself |
| 23-30 | 10 gems worth 100 gp each |
| 31-44 | Wooden ladder (24 feet long) 45-51 A riding horse with saddle bags |
| 52-59 | Pit (a cube 10 feet on a side), which you can place on the ground within 10 feet of you |
| 60-68 | 4 potions of healing |
| 69-75 | Rowboat (12 feet long) |
| 76-83 | Spell scroll containing one spell of 1st to 3rd level |
| 84-90 | 2 mastiffs |
| 91-96 | Window (2 feet by 4 feet, up to 2 feet deep), which you can place on a vertical surface you can reach |
| 97-100 | Portable ram |

items.name: 吸收之杖
items.description: 持有此法杖时，你可以使用反应来吸收一个仅针对你的、且不具有区域效果的法术。该法术的效果被取消，而法术的能量——而非法术本身——被储存在法杖中。能量的等级与施放时的法术等级相同。法杖可以吸收并储存最多50级的能量。一旦法杖吸收了50级能量，它就不能再吸收更多。如果你被一个法杖无法储存的法术命中，则……
items.descriptionEn:
While holding this rod, you can use your reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and not with an area of effect. The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy-not the spell itself-is stored in the rod. The energy has the same level as the spell when it was cast. The rod can absorb and store up to 50 levels of energy over the course of its existence. Once the rod absorbs 50 levels of energy, it can't absorb more. If you are targeted by a spell that the rod can't store, the rod has no effect on that spell.
When you become attuned to the rod, you know how many levels of energy the rod has absorbed over the course of its existence, and how many levels of spell energy it currently has stored.
If you are a spellcaster holding the rod, you can convert energy stored in it into spell slots to cast spells you have prepared or know. You can create spell slots only of a level equal to or lower than your own spell slots, up to a maximum of 5th level. You use the stored levels in place of your slots, but otherwise cast the spell as normal. For example, you can use 3 levels stored in the rod as a 3rd-level spell slot.
A newly found rod has 1d10 levels of spell energy stored in it already. A rod that can no longer absorb spell energy and has no energy remaining becomes nonmagical.

items.name: 警觉之杖
items.description:
这根法杖有一个带齿的头部，具有以下属性。  
***警觉***。持握此法杖时，你在智慧（察觉）检定和先攻掷骰中获得优势。  
***法术***。持握此法杖时，你可以使用一个动作从其中施放以下法术之一：侦测邪恶与善良、侦测魔法、侦测毒药与疾病或看见隐形。  
***防护光环***。作为一次动作，你可以将法杖的杆端插入地面，此时法杖的头部会散发出明亮的光亮，在……
items.descriptionEn:
This rod has a flanged head and the following properties.
***Alertness.*** While holding the rod, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on rolls for initiative.
***Spells.*** While holding the rod, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it: detect evil and good, detect magic, detect poison and disease, or see invisibility.
***Protective Aura.*** As an action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod's head sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet. While in that bright light, you and any creature that is friendly to you gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws and can sense the location of any invisible hostile creature that is also in the bright light.
The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes, or when a creature uses an action to pull the rod from the ground. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

items.name: 王者之力之杖
items.description:
这根法杖有一个带齿的头部，它可作为一件魔法战锤使用，对其攻击和伤害掷骰提供+3加值。法杖的杆身上排列着六个按钮，每个按钮都有不同的属性。它还有三种其他属性，如下所述。  
***六个按钮***。你可以作为附赠动作按下法杖的任意一个按钮。按钮的效果将持续到你按下另一个按钮，或再次按下同一个按钮，此时法杖会恢复到无效果状态。
items.descriptionEn:
This rod has a flanged head, and it functions as a magic mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The rod has properties associated with six different buttons that are set in a row along the haft. It has three other properties as well, detailed below.
***Six Buttons.*** You can press one of the rod's six buttons as a bonus action. A button's effect lasts until you push a different button or until you push the same button again, which causes the rod to revert to its normal form.
If you press **button 1**, the rod becomes a flame tongue, as a fiery blade sprouts from the end opposite the rod's flanged head.
If you press **button 2**, the rod's flanged head folds down and two crescent-shaped blades spring out, transforming the rod into a magic battleaxe that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.
If you press **button 3**, the rod's flanged head folds down, a spear point springs from the rod's tip, and the rod's handle lengthens into a 6-foot haft, transforming the rod into a magic spear that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.
If you press **button 4**, the rod transforms into a climbing pole up to 50 feet long, as you specify. In surfaces as hard as granite, a spike at the bottom and three hooks at the top anchor the pole. Horizontal bars 3 inches long fold out from the sides, 1 foot apart, forming a ladder. The pole can bear up to 4,000 pounds. More weight or lack of solid anchoring causes the rod to revert to its normal form.
If you press **button 5**, the rod transforms into a handheld battering ram and grants its user a +10 bonus to Strength checks made to break through doors, barricades, and other barriers.
If you press **button 6**, the rod assumes or remains in its normal form and indicates magnetic north. (Nothing happens if this function of the rod is used in a location that has no magnetic north.) The rod also gives you knowledge of your approximate depth beneath the ground or your height above it.
***Drain Life.*** When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes an extra 4d6 necrotic damage, and you regain a number of hit points equal to half that necrotic damage. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
***Paralyze.*** When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
***Terrify.*** While holding the rod, you can use an action to force each creature you can see within 30 feet of you to make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a target is frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

items.name: 统治者之杖
items.description: 你可以使用一个动作举起法杖，并命令你可见的120英尺内的每个你选择的生物服从。每个目标必须成功通过DC 15的智力豁免，否则会被你魅惑8小时。在被魅惑期间，该生物将你视为其信任的领袖。如果它受到你或你的同伴的伤害，或被命令做与其本性相违背的事，它将不再被魅惑。法杖要等到下一个黎明才能再次使用。
items.descriptionEn: You can use an action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of you. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 8 hours. While charmed in this way, the creature regards you as its trusted leader. If harmed by you or your companions, or commanded to do something contrary to its nature, a target ceases to be charmed in this way. The rod can't be used again until the next dawn.

items.name: 安全之杖
items.description: 持有此法杖时，你可以使用一个动作激活它。法杖随即瞬间将你和最多199名你可见的自愿生物传送至一个存在于异界空间中的天堂。你选择天堂的形式，它可以是宁静的花园、美丽的林地、欢快的小酒馆、宏伟的宫殿、热带岛屿、奇妙的嘉年华，或其他你能想象的任何东西。无论其形式如何，这个天堂都包含足够的水和食物供访客使用。一切……
items.descriptionEn:
While holding this rod, you can use an action to activate it. The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a paradise that exists in an extraplanar space. You choose the form that the paradise takes. It could be a tranquil garden, lovely glade, cheery tavern, immense palace, tropical island, fantastic carnival, or whatever else you can imagine. Regardless of its nature, the paradise contains enough water and food to sustain its visitors. Everything else that can be interacted with inside the extraplanar space can exist only there. For example, a flower picked from a garden in the paradise disappears if it is taken outside the extraplanar space.
For each hour spent in the paradise, a visitor regains hit points as if it had spent 1 Hit Die. Also, creatures don't age while in the paradise, although time passes normally. Visitors can remain in the paradise for up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures present (round down).
When the time runs out or you use an action to end it, all visitors reappear in the location they occupied when you activated the rod, or an unoccupied space nearest that location. The rod can't be used again until ten days have passed.

items.name: 攀爬绳索
items.description: 这条60英尺长的丝绸绳索重3磅，可承重3000磅。如果你手持绳子一端并用一个动作说出咒语，绳子会活化。作为附带动作，你可以命令另一端移动到你选择的目的地。该端在你第一次命令它时会在你的回合移动10英尺，并在之后每个回合继续移动10英尺，直到到达目的地、达到最大长度或你下令停止。你也可以命令绳子自行固定。
items.descriptionEn:
This 60-foot length of silk rope weighs 3 pounds and can hold up to 3,000 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak the command word, the rope animates. As a bonus action, you can command the other end to move toward a destination you choose. That end moves 10 feet on your turn when you first command it and 10 feet on each of your turns until reaching its destination, up to its maximum length away, or until you tell it to stop. You can also tell the rope to fasten itself securely to an object or to unfasten itself, to knot or unknot itself, or to coil itself for carrying.
If you tell the rope to knot, large knots appear at 1 foot intervals along the rope. While knotted, the rope shortens to a 50-foot length and grants advantage on checks made to climb it.
The rope has AC 20 and 20 hit points. It regains 1 hit point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 hit point. If the rope drops to 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

items.name: 缠绕绳索
items.description: 这条绳子长30英尺，重3磅。如果你手持绳子一端并用一个动作说出其咒语，另一端会向前弹出以缠绕你可见的20英尺内的生物。目标必须成功通过DC 15的敏捷豁免，否则会被束缚。你可以通过使用附带动作说出第二个咒语来释放该生物。被绳子束缚的生物可以使用一个动作进行一次DC 15的力量或敏捷检定（由目标选择）。若成功，
items.descriptionEn:
This rope is 30 feet long and weighs 3 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak its command word, the other end darts forward to entangle a creature you can see within 20 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become restrained.
You can release the creature by using a bonus action to speak a second command word. A target restrained by the rope can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check (target's choice). On a success, the creature is no longer restrained by the rope.
The rope has AC 20 and 20 hit points. It regains 1 hit point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 hit point. If the rope drops to 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

items.name: 防护圣甲虫
items.description:
如果你手持这个甲虫形状的吊坠持续1轮，其表面会出现铭文，揭示其魔法性质。当它在你身上时，你会获得以下两个好处：  
你在对抗法术的豁免中具有优势。  
此圣甲虫有12次充能。如果你对一个亡灵生物造成的有害效果或死灵法术的豁免失败，你可以用反应消耗1次充能，将失败的豁免变为成功。圣甲虫会碎成粉末。
items.descriptionEn:
If you hold this beetle-shaped medallion in your hand for 1 round, an inscription appears on its surface revealing its magical nature. It provides two benefits while it is on your person:
You have advantage on saving throws against spells.
The scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an undead creature, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.

items.name: 迅捷弯刀
items.description: 你使用这件魔法武器进行攻击和伤害掷骰时获得+2加成。此外，你可以在每个回合中作为附带动作进行一次攻击。
items.descriptionEn: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a bonus action on each of your turns.

items.name: 弹幕吸引护盾
items.description:
持有此盾牌时，你对远程武器攻击的伤害具有抗性。  
***诅咒。*** 此盾牌被诅咒。当你与之共鸣时，你会被诅咒，直到被驱邪术或类似魔法针对。移除盾牌无法解除诅咒。每当有远程武器攻击在你10英尺内目标时，诅咒会使你成为攻击目标。
items.descriptionEn:
While holding this shield, you have resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks.
***Curse.*** This shield is cursed. Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by the remove curse spell or similar magic. Removing the shield fails to end the curse on you. Whenever a ranged weapon attack is made against a target within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

items.name: 蜘蛛足靴
items.description: 你穿戴这双轻便的鞋子时，可以在垂直表面和倒悬于天花板上自由移动，同时双手保持自由。你的攀爬速度等于你的步行速度。然而，这些软鞋不允许你在滑腻的表面上（如冰面或油面）这样移动。
items.descriptionEn: While you wear these light shoes, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. However, the slippers don't allow you to move this way on a slippery surface, such as one covered by ice or oil.

effects: move up, down, and across vertical surfaces
climbing speed equal to walking speed

items.name: 至高胶水
items.description:
这种粘稠的乳白色物质可以永久地将任何两个物体粘合在一起。它必须存放在内部涂有滑腻油的罐子或瓶中。发现时，容器内含有1d6 + 1盎司的物质。  
一盎司的胶水可以覆盖1平方英尺的表面。胶水需要1分钟才能凝固。一旦凝固，只有通过万能溶剂、以太油或愿望术才能打破其粘合。如果施法过程未被打断，卷轴不会丢失。
items.descriptionEn:
This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with oil of slipperiness. When found, a container contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.
One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. The glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of universal solvent or oil of etherealness, or with a wish spell.

items.name: 法术卷轴
items.description:
一张法术卷轴上写着一个法术的词句，以神秘密码书写。如果该法术在你的职业法术列表中，你可以阅读卷轴并施放该法术，无需提供任何材料成分。否则，卷轴无法理解。通过阅读卷轴施放法术需要该法术正常的施法时间。一旦法术被施放，卷轴上的文字会消失，并化为尘土。如果施法过程未被打断，卷轴不会丢失。  
如果该法术在你的职业的
items.descriptionEn:
A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without providing any material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade, and it crumbles to dust. If the casting is uninterrupted, the scroll is not lost.
If the spell is on your class's spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you must make an ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast it successfully. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.
The level of the spell on the scroll determines the spell's saving throw DC and attack bonus, as well as the scroll's rarity, as shown in the Spell Scroll table.
Spell Scroll (table)
| Spell Level | Rarity | Save DC | Attack Bonus |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cantrip | Common | 13 | +5 |
| 1st | Common | 13 | +5 |
| 2nd | Uncommon | 13 | +5 |
| 3rd | Uncommon | 15 | +7 |
| 4th | Rare | 15 | +7 |
| 5th | Rare | 17 | +9 |
| 6th | Very rare | 17 | +9 |
| 7th | Very rare | 18 | +10 |
| 8th | Very rare | 18 | +10 |
| 9th | Legendary | 19 | +11 |
A wizard spell on a spell scroll can be copied just as spells in spellbooks can be copied. When a spell is copied from a spell scroll, the copier must succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check with a DC equal to 10 + the spell's level. If the check succeeds, the spell is successfully copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the spell scroll is destroyed.
